features.description: Clusters the workflow-execution actor subsystem: replaces the in-process actor provider with a distributed one that routes commands by per-execution placement lease and a durable cross-node command transport, and runs a placement pump that renews leases and re-drives backlog on failover. Double execution is prevented by W5's fencing token at checkpoint commit. Compose alongside the Tasks feature.

options.description: Placement and transport visibility lease TTL. A node that stops renewing within this window loses its executions to a survivor.
options.name: LeaseDurationSeconds

options.description: Upper bound the sweep interval widens to under sustained failure.
options.name: MaxBackoffIntervalMinutes

options.description: Hard cap on executions claimed and re-driven per sweep, bounding dispatch bursts.
options.name: MaxExecutionsPerSweep

options.description: Stable identity of this node as a placement owner, up to 128 well-formed UTF-16 code units. Defaults to a machine/process-derived value.
options.name: NodeId

options.description: Baseline seconds between placement sweeps (lease renewal + backlog re-drive) while the node is healthy.
options.name: SweepIntervalSeconds

options.description: Maximum transport items leased per owned execution per sweep.
options.name: TransportLeaseBatchSize
